## About
Kwik Shift Transmissions is a transmission shop on Nevada St in Pleasanton. We service, repair and rebuild automatic and manual transmissions, and we work on clutches, transfer cases, differentials and the rest of the powertrain.
When you bring your vehicle in, we examine and evaluate your transmission at no charge. Then we give you an estimate and a clear explanation of any repair or rebuild we recommend. We also service extended warranty contracts, and our work is fully warrantied.
Customers have rated us 4.9 on Google from 37 reviews. One reviewer trusted us with a classic Camaro, and another had a GMC Sierra towed in for a transmission replacement.

## Services
- Transmission repair and rebuilds: Service, repair and rebuilds for manual and automatic transmissions on all makes and models.
- New transmission installation: We install new transmissions.
- Standard clutch repair: Clutch work for manual cars. One reviewer brought in a Subaru WRX for a new clutch and said it feels great.
- ATF flush service: Automatic transmission fluid flush as part of keeping your transmission in good shape.
- Transfer case repair: Repair work on transfer cases.

## FAQ
Q: Do you give free estimates?
A: Yes. We offer a free estimate on any transmission work, including warranty work.

Q: Do you work with extended warranty contracts?
A: Yes, we service extended warranty contracts.

Q: What are your hours?
A: We are open Monday through Friday from 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. Saturdays are by appointment only, so call ahead.
